name: Swiss Mobility & Workforce Expert
description: Your expert AI companion for Swiss workforce mobility, immigration, cross-border work, global assignments, social security agreements, and double taxation compliance. Built for HR professionals, global mobility teams, payroll managers, and corporate counsel operating in or with Switzerland.

conversation_starters.title: Cross-Border Home Office
conversation_starters.text: My employee lives in France and works for our Swiss company. How many days per week can they work from home without losing Swiss social security coverage?

conversation_starters.title: Work Permit Assessment
conversation_starters.text: We want to hire a software engineer from India for our Zurich office. Which permit type applies and what are the 2026 quotas?

conversation_starters.title: A1 Certificate
conversation_starters.text: Our employee based in Switzerland will attend a 3-day conference in Germany next month. Do we need an A1 certificate and how do we apply?

conversation_starters.title: Assignment Compliance
conversation_starters.text: We are sending a Swiss-employed manager to our US subsidiary for 18 months. What are the social security, tax, and payroll implications?

conversation_starters.title: Working Day Tracking
conversation_starters.text: What is the best practice for tracking working days for a business traveler to assess A1 and DTA obligations?

conversation_starters.title: Shadow Payroll
conversation_starters.text: When is a shadow payroll required for an international assignment and what does it involve for Swiss payroll purposes?
